prompt: Create an insurance claim form with the customer's full name, email, vehicle type, and incident description.
Create an equipment rental request with requester name, equipment type, rental start date, rental end date, and notes.
Create a travel reimbursement form with employee name, trip destination, travel date, amount, and receipt notes.
Create an employee onboarding checklist with employee name, department, start date, laptop required, and access notes.
Create a building maintenance request with requester name, location, issue type, urgency, and issue description.
Create a customer feedback form with customer name, rating, product area, would recommend choice, and comments.
Create an employee leave request with employee name, leave type, start date, end date, and reason.
Create a bug report with reporter name, affected feature, severity, steps to reproduce, and expected behavior.
Create a vendor registration form with company name, contact name, email, service category, and tax identifier.
Create an event RSVP form with attendee name, email, attendance choice, guest count, and dietary requirements.
Create a job application form with applicant name, email, portfolio URL, years of experience, and cover letter.
Create a support ticket form with customer email, category, priority, subject, and details.
Create an expense report with employee name, expense category, expense date, amount, and business purpose.
Create a property inspection form with property address, inspector name, inspection date, condition rating, and findings.
Create a course registration form with student name, email, course selection, learning mode, and accessibility needs.
Create a product return form with order number, customer email, return reason, item condition, and comments.
Create a volunteer signup form with volunteer name, email, preferred role, availability, and relevant experience.
Create an internal access request with requester name, system name, access level, business justification, and expiry date.
Create a medical appointment request with patient name, email, appointment type, preferred date, and symptoms.
Create a content brief with project name, audience, content type, due date, and key message.
Create a purchase request with requester name, item name, quantity, estimated cost, and justification.
Create a room booking form with requester name, room, booking date, start time, end time, and meeting purpose.
Create a scholarship application with applicant name, email, school, study program, household income, and personal statement.
Create a workplace incident report with reporter name, incident date, location, incident type, people involved, and description.
Create a newsletter signup with full name, email, company, interests, and marketing consent.
Create a design review request with requester name, project name, review type, deadline, design link, and context.
Create a delivery address form with recipient name, phone number, street address, city, postal code, and delivery instructions.
Create an on-call handoff form with engineer name, service, handoff date, open incidents, risks, and follow-up actions.
Create a research interview screener with participant name, email, age range, product usage frequency, and consent.
Create a marketing approval form with campaign name, owner, channel, launch date, target audience, and approval notes.
Create a data deletion request with requester email, account identifier, deletion scope, reason, and confirmation.
